breaking_news.headline: Trump strips job protections from 8,000 federal workers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump signed an executive order that puts some 8,000 high-ranking civil servants into a new category of employees who can be fired for any reason.

breaking_news.headline: A former GEO Group executive now runs ICE. The company's government ties run deep
breaking_news.summary: David Venturella's appointment as acting ICE director is the latest in a pattern: Many former employees of the private prison company GEO Group end up working at the federal agency, and vice versa.

breaking_news.headline: As Strait of Hormuz stays shut, companies seek new routes for trade
breaking_news.summary: Shipping companies are looking for alternative routes as the Strait of Hormuz lockdown drags on.

breaking_news.headline: How cellphone carriers prepare for hurricane season with AI, drones and 'cows'
breaking_news.summary: Hurricane season is expected to be milder than usual this year. But that's not stopping cell phone companies from pulling out all the stops.

breaking_news.headline: What do you actually get when you pay for AI?
breaking_news.summary: Just 3% of U.S. households pay for AI for personal use. Sign ups are growing — even though Americans have subscription fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: A global World Cup tradition catches fire in the U.S.: Panini sticker collecting
breaking_news.summary: Collecting Panini stickers is a World Cup tradition beloved in Europe and Latin America. In the U.S., interest has been building steadily, and this summer, the buzz is bigger than ever.

breaking_news.headline: The U.S. adds 172,000 jobs. Many are in restaurants, bars and hotels
breaking_news.summary: U.S. employers added jobs for the third month in a row in May, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3%. But wage gains softened and likely failed to keep pace with rising prices.

breaking_news.headline: In the wake of layoffs, some tech workers are exploring new careers
breaking_news.summary: Amid widespread tech layoffs, some highly skilled workers are making radical career changes. Some laid-off workers are turning to lower paying temp jobs, and some are leaving tech altogether.

breaking_news.headline: Norway's crown princess on lung transplant waiting list, palace says
breaking_news.summary: Mette-Marit's condition, which stiffens the lungs, making it hard to breathe, has deteriorated, the royal household says.

breaking_news.headline: Three jailed over heist of ancient golden helmet from Dutch museum
breaking_news.summary: The men are sentenced to 47 months each for stealing the 2,500-year-old Romanian Coțofenești helmet.

breaking_news.headline: US actor James Handy stabbed to death, with girlfriend's son arrested
breaking_news.summary: Handy, 81, is known for his roles in films including Jumanji and Top Gun: Maverick.

breaking_news.headline: Nearly 50 people die of thirst in Sahara desert after lorry breaks down
breaking_news.summary: Only two survived after trekking more than 50km (30 miles) across the desert to alert the authorities.

breaking_news.headline: Fury in France after child murder suspect's criminal record released
breaking_news.summary: A man suspected of murdering an 11-year-old girl had previously been identified as a potential child molester, records show.

breaking_news.headline: Astronauts return to ISS after sheltering during air leak repair attempt
breaking_news.summary: Russian attempt to repair tunnel area sparks safe-haven procedure for five other astronauts onboard.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine strikes cargo ships and admits Romania drone blast
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine says it struck five ships carrying illegal cargo in the Sea of Azov and in coastal waters of Russian-occupied territories.

breaking_news.headline: Putin says there is 'no point' meeting Zelensky over ending Ukraine war
breaking_news.summary: The Russian president's refusal comes after his Ukrainian counterpart wrote an open letter calling for face-to-face talks.

breaking_news.headline: British Heart Foundation plans to close 150 charity shops
breaking_news.summary: The charity says it is facing "an exceptionally challenging trading environment".

breaking_news.headline: Is there an AI stock market bubble, and is it ready to burst?
breaking_news.summary: Despite the Iran war, inflation and debt fears, US markets keep hitting record highs, fueled largely by AI. BBC's Samira Hussain looks into whether that bubble will burst.

breaking_news.headline: The ancient trick making food waste useful and tasty
breaking_news.summary: Instead of throwing away byproducts of food processing, fermentation is making them valuable.

breaking_news.headline: Hospitality jobs boom as US prepares for World Cup
breaking_news.summary: It is the third month in a row US jobs figures have beaten expectations.
